Shuben Launcher 1.3

Shuben Launcher

A Minecraft launcher for Windows and macOS with Microsoft login, a built-in mod and resource pack store, skins, capes, and one-click servers.

DownloadWindows & macOS Join Discordcommunity & support

Everything in one launcher

Shuben account

Sign up with email or Google. Up to 3 Microsoft accounts. Switch profiles instantly from your avatar.

Default mode

No purchase needed. Default runs the free Mojang demo with Fabric, Sodium and Night Vision pre-installed. It stays the demo.

Skins & capes

Upload a skin and switch between capes your account owns, right from the launcher.

Mod & resource pack store

Search Modrinth, filter by version and loader, install with required dependencies in one click.

Servers

Create a plain server, upload a .mrpack, or on Windows pick any modpack folder. Real dedicated server on the IP you choose.

Smart memory

The launcher reads your PC's actual RAM and caps the slider automatically. No 16 GB option on a 6 GB machine.

Always up to date

Checks for the latest releases and snapshots. Shows a notification bar when a new launcher version is available.

Download

Windows 11.exe installer · 101 MB macOS Apple Silicon.dmg · 137 MB MacBook Neo (A18).dmg · 137 MB macOS Intel.dmg · 142 MB

Windows: installer puts Shuben Launcher in Program Files with a Start Menu shortcut. Mac: open the .dmg and drag to Applications. Unsigned — Windows: More info → Run anyway; Mac: right-click → Open.
